sql: /* Query 10: filter5_agg1_join2 (player, team, city, manager) */ SELECT player.team, SUM(city.area) AS sum_city_area FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN manager ON team.ownership = manager.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name WHERE player.draft_year <= 2005 OR player.position = 'Backcourt' OR player.draft_pick <= 41 GROUP BY player.team

team.description: the current NBA team the player belongs to, or the last NBA team the player joined if not currently active (e.g., Los Angeles Lakers).

area.description: area is the area of the city in square kilometers (e.g. 89.64).
